XXXV.
THEOLOGIA IRENICA.
I. Theologia irenica est doctrina de com-
ponendis controuersiis in religione. Di-
citur aliâs polemica.
II. Eius partes duæ sunt: vna communis, al-
tera specialis & propria.
III. Pars communis monstrat in genere mo-
dum componendi controuersias theologicas.
Quâ de re sunt istæ regulæ. 1. Illa in N.T. est vera fides, cuius
author est solus Christus & Apostolipræcones. Hæc est illa fides,
ad quam Paulus Corinthios reuocabat, vt labefactatam
interillos doctrinam de sacra eucharistia in integrum re-
stituerent. Ego, inquit, à Domino accepi, quod & tradidi vobis,
1.Cor.11.v.23. Ea est fides, ad quam idem Apostolus etiam
Galatas reuocabat, tantâ contentione affirmans, aliud
nullum esse Euangelium, nisi illud, quod ipse eis prædi-
cauerit: nihil dubitans Spiritu Dei plenus, etiam de cœlo
venientibus angelis anathema dicere, si aliquid aliud do-
ctrinæ fidei adiicerent, παρ' ὃ παρελάβετε, præter id quod
accepistis, Gal.1.v.6.7.8.9. Ea est fides, ad quam Iudas versu 4.
omnes omnium ecclesiarum fideles reuocabat, cum pul-

page.notes: Left margin line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) are printed and kept as notes. Doubtful readings: the Greek in the Galatians and Jude passages (παρ' ὃ παρελάβετε; ἐπαγωνίζεσθαι τῇ ἅπαξ παραδοθείσῃ πίστει τοῖς ἁγίοις) was read from a small and blurred print, so the accents and some letters may differ. "Apostolipræcones" is printed without a space and is kept as it appears. The hyphen in "dida-sticæ" is a line-end hyphen. The catchword "trouer-" is the start of the word "controuersias" on the next page.
